verdict.rationale: stagewise is a desktop agentic IDE where agents run interactively from chat sessions. The evidence shows parallel agents, a keep-awake setting and a GitHub plugin with actions access. None of these documents agents that run on a recurring schedule or fire automatically on triggers. Scheduled or triggered autonomous agents are a fair axis for an agentic IDE, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to maintain and fix my software autonomously
